facts.claim: Every paladin learns Holy Strike at level 6: instant Holy damage based on weapon damage.
Seal of Fury at level 10: tank seal, flat Holy damage per swing, absorb shield with a shield equipped; Judgement of it taunts (10 yd).
Consecration is baseline at level 20. It hits the first 4 enemies hard and others very lightly.
Blessing of Kings is baseline from level 20.
Judgement no longer consumes your Seal.
Sacred Arbiter (16-point tier): Holy Strike deals 20% more damage and refreshes all Judgement effects on the target, including other paladins'.
Seal of Command: chance to deal 70% weapon damage as Holy; best with a slow two-hander. Judgement of Command does double damage to stunned targets.
Vengeance requires Seal of Command (since 2 Nov); up to 5 stacks for 30 s.

Unsealed Wrath (31-point, after Repentance): melee stores a copy of the active Seal, up to 3 stacks for 15 s. An attack under a different Seal consumes the stacks, each with the stored Seal's normal proc chance.
Seal twisting is no longer baseline; the Twist of Light talent brings back a controlled version.

Wolfsbane chain: Diplomatic Incident (Danitha Morr, Bandarion Keep) → Trevan Rol steps → A Moon-Kissed Blade → An Underrated Talent / Ott's Masterwork (Ott, Tarren Mill) → The Moonsilver Blade → Old Fire-Eye (level 25 elite worgen, Silverpine) → Wolfsbane.

A Moon-Kissed Blade (95036): Undead-only Horde paladin quest, level 25 (requires 20). Needs Whitestone Oak Lumber (Deadmines, Goblin Woodcarvers near Sneed), Enchanted Silver Ingot (Shadowfang Keep) and Purified Kor Gem (Blackfathom Deeps). Turn in to Trevan Rol near the Sepulcher (~43.3, 41.0 Silverpine).
A Moon-Kissed Blade XP reward: 2,500 (2.5× normal).
Wolfsbane: two-handed sword, 25.59 DPS, +9 Stamina, +10 Intellect; proc 39–59 Holy, tripled against wolves and worgen. Swing speed not found.

steps: Pre-pull Seal of the Crusader → Judgement (debuff) → switch to Seal of Command and keep it.
Holy Strike and Judgement on cooldown. Holy Strike keeps Judgement effects refreshed (Sacred Arbiter).
Hammer of Justice → Judgement for double Judgement of Command damage.
Consecration on 3+ targets (in groups, once the tank has threat).
In groups: Righteous Fury off. Blessing of Might on melee, Wisdom on healer/casters, Kings otherwise.
Short trash: skip Crusader, go straight to Command.
rotations.notes: Minority view (maxroll): alternate Command and Righteousness by swing timing.
